description: This file defines the Sdg class representing Sustainable Development Goals within the Goteo project. It includes methods for retrieving, listing, saving, and validating SDG data, and manages related images and translations.

classes.name: Sdg
classes.description: Model class for managing Sustainable Development Goals, including CRUD operations, localization, and image handling.

methods.name: getLangFields
methods.description: Returns the list of translatable fields: name, description, link.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves an SDG instance by ID, optionally in a specific language.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Lists SDGs with optional filters, pagination, and count.

methods.name: getIcon
methods.description: Returns the icon image for the SDG, optionally forcing asset retrieval.

methods.name: setIcon
methods.description: Sets the icon for the SDG, accepting an Image object or icon ID.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Validates and saves the SDG object to the database.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the SDG data, ensuring required fields like name are present.
